source.title: Story, Narrative, Literature, Poetry, Lyrics, Comics, and Game Writing Skill Catalog
source.note: Categories, Skill Tool Names and Descriptions transcribed from the supplied catalog PDF. Descriptions are the source text used for keyword matching and prompts.

skills.name: Story Premise Architect
skills.description: Turns a theme, image, question, mechanic, character, or audience need into a durable dramatic premise with conflict and transformation.

skills.name: Narrative North Star Designer
skills.description: Defines the emotional promise, thematic question, reader experience, boundaries, and completion criteria that guide an entire work.

skills.name: Story Concept Generator
skills.description: Develops original high-concept and intimate story ideas across genres, media, lengths, audiences, and production constraints.

skills.name: Creative Territory Explorer
skills.description: Produces distinct narrative directions with different worlds, tones, structures, protagonists, and risks rather than superficial variants.

skills.name: Narrative Brief Interpreter
skills.description: Converts requested genre, format, length, age range, themes, canon, content limits, and deliverables into an actionable writing brief.

skills.name: Audience Engagement Strategist
skills.description: Plans curiosity, identification, surprise, suspense, humor, wonder, empathy, and payoff for a defined readership or player base.

skills.name: Tone and Atmosphere Director
skills.description: Establishes voice, mood, intensity, sensory character, emotional temperature, and rules for tonal shifts.

skills.name: Narrative Constraint Designer
skills.description: Uses word count, page count, cast size, setting, timeline, viewpoint, budget, and platform limits to strengthen the story.

skills.name: Originality and Influence Reviewer
skills.description: Identifies excessive similarity to existing works and redirects concepts toward original combinations, structures, and expression.

skills.name: Story Feasibility Planner
skills.description: Tests whether the proposed scope, cast, arc, branching, research, art, audio, and production needs fit the intended medium.

skills.name: Narrative Quality Rubric Author
skills.description: Creates measurable criteria for coherence, character, theme, pacing, prose, originality, emotional impact, and format readiness.

skills.name: Long-Form Completion Architect
skills.description: Breaks very large or open-ended works into volumes, arcs, milestones, continuity gates, and satisfying intermediate completions.

skills.name: Theme Development Specialist
skills.description: Builds a thematic question and competing answers that emerge through character choices, consequences, images, and outcomes.

skills.name: Moral Complexity Designer
skills.description: Creates conflicts with credible values, trade-offs, blind spots, and consequences instead of simplistic moral labeling.

skills.name: Emotional Arc Designer
skills.description: Plans the intended emotional movement of scenes, chapters, acts, episodes, routes, and the complete work.

skills.name: Meaningful Motif Designer
skills.description: Develops recurring objects, phrases, colors, places, sounds, and actions whose meaning changes with the story.

skills.name: Symbolism Architect
skills.description: Uses symbols with narrative function, cultural awareness, variation, and restraint rather than decorative obscurity.

skills.name: Subtext Designer
skills.description: Creates dialogue and action where spoken intent, hidden desire, social pressure, and audience understanding interact.

skills.name: Catharsis and Payoff Designer
skills.description: Builds earned emotional release through setup, escalation, recognition, choice, cost, and aftermath.

skills.name: Hope and Despair Balance Designer
skills.description: Controls darkness, relief, agency, connection, and possibility so intense stories remain purposeful.

skills.name: Philosophical Narrative Designer
skills.description: Dramatizes competing philosophical positions through lived decisions and consequences without turning characters into lectures.

skills.name: Cultural Meaning Reviewer
skills.description: Checks symbols, rituals, values, humor, conflict, and representation for context, specificity, and avoidable harm.

skills.name: Emotional Authenticity Editor
skills.description: Revises reactions, grief, joy, fear, intimacy, recovery, and change to fit character history and circumstance.

skills.name: Theme Consistency Auditor
skills.description: Tracks where theme is introduced, challenged, embodied, contradicted, transformed, and resolved.

skills.name: Plot Architecture Designer
skills.description: Builds causally connected goals, obstacles, reversals, revelations, choices, consequences, climax, and resolution.

skills.name: Three-Act Structure Specialist
skills.description: Uses setup, confrontation, and resolution flexibly while preserving character causality and avoiding mechanical beats.

skills.name: Five-Act and Dramatic Structure Specialist
skills.description: Designs escalation, turning points, complications, crisis, climax, and denouement for stage- like or expansive narratives.

skills.name: Hero Journey Adaptation Designer
skills.description: Uses departure, initiation, and return patterns only where appropriate, adapting them to the character and culture.

skills.name: Save-the-Cat Beat Analyst
skills.description: Uses recognizable commercial beats diagnostically without forcing every story into the same sequence.

skills.name: Kishotenketsu Structure Designer
skills.description: Builds introduction, development, twist, and reconciliation structures that can operate without conflict-centric plotting.

skills.name: Nonlinear Narrative Architect
skills.description: Designs flashbacks, flashforwards, loops, fragments, parallel times, reverse chronology, and delayed context with clear orientation.

skills.name: Nested Story Designer
skills.description: Creates stories within stories whose structure, voice, and meaning interact with the framing narrative.

skills.name: Parallel Plot Weaver
skills.description: Coordinates multiple plots so their themes, decisions, timing, and climaxes reinforce or productively contrast.

skills.name: Mystery Plot Engineer
skills.description: Plans crime or puzzle, truth, clues, red herrings, suspects, investigative steps, reversals, and fair revelation.

skills.name: Twist and Revelation Designer
skills.description: Creates surprising but retrospectively supported revelations that alter understanding and future action.

skills.name: Ending and Resolution Architect
skills.description: Builds endings that resolve the central promise, character movement, consequences, theme, and appropriate remaining ambiguity.

skills.name: Scene Purpose Designer
skills.description: Defines each scene by viewpoint goal, obstacle, tactic, change, new information, emotional movement, and exit condition.

skills.name: Scene Opening Specialist
skills.description: Creates openings with orientation, disturbance, voice, image, tension, or immediate purpose suited to the work.

skills.name: Scene Escalation Designer
skills.description: Raises pressure through stronger obstacles, narrowing options, cost, urgency, exposure, and irreversible decisions.

skills.name: Scene Turn and Reversal Designer
skills.description: Creates meaningful changes in power, knowledge, intention, relationship, or circumstance within a scene.

skills.name: Scene Ending and Hook Designer
skills.description: Ends on decision, revelation, threat, image, question, reversal, or emotional resonance without repetitive cliffhangers.

skills.name: Sequence Architect
skills.description: Groups scenes into purposeful sequences with setup, pursuit, complication, culmination, and consequence.

skills.name: Chapter Designer
skills.description: Builds chapters with internal shape, viewpoint control, pacing, transitions, thematic function, and reader momentum.

skills.name: Transition Specialist
skills.description: Creates clear and elegant transitions across time, place, viewpoint, tone, montage, memory, and parallel action.

skills.name: Montage and Compression Writer
skills.description: Condenses repeated effort, travel, training, investigation, or relationship growth while preserving selected vivid moments.

skills.name: Dramatic Expansion Writer
skills.description: Slows crucial moments through sensory attention, thought, action, dialogue, and micro- decisions without padding.

skills.name: Scene Continuity Auditor
skills.description: Checks entrances, exits, positions, objects, wounds, knowledge, time, weather, clothing, and causal carryover.

skills.name: Chapter Rhythm Auditor
skills.description: Reviews variation in length, intensity, viewpoint, information, action, reflection, and ending type.

skills.name: Protagonist Designer
skills.description: Creates a central character with desire, need, contradiction, capability, vulnerability, history, and capacity for consequential choice.

skills.name: Antagonist Designer
skills.description: Builds a credible opposing force with goals, values, methods, strengths, limits, and pressure on the protagonist.

skills.name: Supporting Cast Designer
skills.description: Creates allies, rivals, mentors, dependents, foils, witnesses, and complications with independent motives and functions.

skills.name: Character Arc Architect
skills.description: Plans positive, negative, flat, disillusionment, corruption, recovery, and transformation arcs through choices and consequences.

skills.name: Character Backstory Designer
skills.description: Creates only the history needed to drive present behavior, relationships, fear, skill, belief, and unresolved conflict.

skills.name: Character Contradiction Designer
skills.description: Builds believable tensions between self-image, behavior, desire, fear, values, habits, and social role.

skills.name: Character Voice Designer
skills.description: Defines vocabulary, rhythm, imagery, formality, humor, silence, and context-dependent speech patterns.

skills.name: Character Relationship Architect
skills.description: Designs changing bonds through power, trust, intimacy, obligation, rivalry, misunderstanding, and shared history.

skills.name: Character Agency Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether major characters initiate action, make meaningful choices, and affect outcomes rather than merely receive plot.

skills.name: Character Consistency and Growth Auditor
skills.description: Tracks stable traits, pressure responses, learning, relapse, earned change, and scene-level behavior.

skills.name: Ensemble Cast Balancer
skills.description: Distributes purpose, attention, arcs, viewpoints, conflicts, and payoff across a large cast.

skills.name: Character Bible Author
skills.description: Documents identity, appearance, history, goals, fears, relationships, voice, knowledge, arc, and continuity facts.

skills.name: Dialogue Scene Writer
skills.description: Writes purposeful conversation shaped by goals, tactics, status, history, setting, interruption, and subtext.

skills.name: Distinct Voice Specialist
skills.description: Separates speakers through worldview, rhythm, vocabulary, metaphor, politeness, directness, and avoidance patterns.

skills.name: Subtextual Dialogue Designer
skills.description: Creates exchanges where characters pursue hidden goals and the audience understands more than is said.

skills.name: Banter and Verbal Chemistry Writer
skills.description: Builds playful conflict, timing, callbacks, status shifts, affection, and distinct comedic rhythm.

skills.name: Argument and Confrontation Writer
skills.description: Creates escalating disagreement with valid positions, tactical changes, emotional stakes, and consequential turns.

skills.name: Exposition Dialogue Repairer
skills.description: Moves necessary information into conflict, discovery, implication, action, or character-specific language.

skills.name: Monologue and Soliloquy Writer
skills.description: Creates sustained speech with progression, revelation, rhetoric, internal turns, and performance rhythm.

skills.name: Interview and Interrogation Scene Writer
skills.description: Designs questions, resistance, deception, leverage, silence, evidence, and changing control.

skills.name: Group Conversation Choreographer
skills.description: Manages multiple speakers, interruptions, alliances, reactions, spatial cues, and topic shifts without confusion.

skills.name: Dialogue Tag and Action Beat Editor
skills.description: Balances attribution, gesture, pacing, clarity, and subtext while avoiding repetitive or distracting tags.

skills.name: Speech Realism Calibrator
skills.description: Adjusts dialogue between naturalism and compression according to genre, medium, period, and audience.

skills.name: Dialogue Continuity Auditor
skills.description: Tracks knowledge, lies, promises, terminology, accents, relationships, and callbacks across the work.

skills.name: World Premise Designer
skills.description: Defines what makes the setting fundamentally distinct and how that difference changes daily life and conflict.

skills.name: Lore Architecture Designer
skills.description: Organizes origins, eras, peoples, places, institutions, conflicts, myths, technologies, and unresolved questions.

skills.name: History and Timeline Builder
skills.description: Creates eras, causes, turning points, migrations, discoveries, disasters, reforms, and contested interpretations.

skills.name: Culture Designer
skills.description: Builds values, customs, family, work, art, food, dress, humor, etiquette, taboos, and internal diversity.

skills.name: Religion and Mythology Designer
skills.description: Creates beliefs, practices, institutions, myths, schisms, sacred places, ethics, and everyday influence.

skills.name: Political System Designer
skills.description: Builds authority, law, legitimacy, succession, factions, administration, opposition, and sources of instability.

skills.name: Economic and Trade System Designer
skills.description: Creates resources, labor, production, exchange, class, scarcity, routes, incentives, and material consequences.

skills.name: Technology and Infrastructure Designer
skills.description: Defines invention, access, maintenance, transport, communication, energy, weapons, medicine, and social effects.

skills.name: Ecology and Creature System Designer
skills.description: Creates climates, biomes, food webs, species, adaptation, domestication, hazards, and human environmental impact.

skills.name: Language and Naming System Designer
skills.description: Creates phonetic patterns, naming conventions, titles, terms, idioms, and language relationships without requiring a full conlang.

skills.name: Worldbuilding Consequence Auditor
skills.description: Tests how magic, technology, geography, history, and institutions alter economics, warfare, family, law, and daily routines.

skills.name: Lore Bible Author
skills.description: Maintains canon, dates, terms, maps, cultures, systems, unresolved mysteries, sources, and revision history.

skills.name: Magic System Architect
skills.description: Defines source, access, rules, limits, costs, learning, institutions, edge cases, and narrative consequences.

skills.name: Soft Magic Atmosphere Designer
skills.description: Creates wonder, mystery, symbolism, uncertainty, and emotional logic without over- explaining the supernatural.

skills.name: Hard Magic Rule Designer
skills.description: Builds explicit capabilities, constraints, interactions, exploits, counters, and testable consistency.

skills.name: Power System Balancer
skills.description: Designs abilities, progression, drawbacks, matchups, teamwork, environment use, and escalation without arbitrary outcomes.

skills.name: Supernatural Entity Designer
skills.description: Creates spirits, gods, monsters, anomalies, curses, and other beings with rules, motives, signs, and cultural interpretations.

skills.name: Prophecy and Fate Designer
skills.description: Uses prophecy, destiny, interpretation, self-fulfillment, resistance, and ambiguity without removing agency.

skills.name: Time Travel Logic Designer
skills.description: Defines timeline model, causality, paradox handling, memory, branching, constraints, and emotional consequences.

skills.name: Multiverse Narrative Designer
skills.description: Creates meaningful alternate worlds with divergence points, thematic contrasts, travel rules, and identity consequences.

skills.name: Science Fiction Plausibility Designer
skills.description: Builds extrapolated technology and societies with stated assumptions, limits, second-order effects, and human stakes.

skills.name: Speculative Society Designer
skills.description: Explores how one altered condition reshapes institutions, relationships, language, work, identity, and conflict.

skills.name: System Exploit and Edge-Case Auditor
skills.description: Finds loopholes, contradictions, unintended capabilities, trivial solutions, and missing societal adaptations.

skills.name: Power Escalation Auditor
skills.description: Checks scale, stakes, counterplay, cost, spectacle, and continuity as abilities grow.

skills.name: Location Lore Designer
skills.description: Creates places with history, function, inhabitants, conflict, sensory identity, and changing meaning.

skills.name: City and Settlement Designer
skills.description: Builds districts, infrastructure, power, economy, landmarks, movement, class, services, and local tensions.

skills.name: Dungeon and Adventure Site Designer
skills.description: Creates navigable spaces with purpose, history, inhabitants, hazards, puzzles, choices, and environmental storytelling.

skills.name: Landscape Narrative Designer
skills.description: Uses terrain, climate, ecology, travel, visibility, resources, and danger to shape plot and culture.

skills.name: Building and Interior Story Designer
skills.description: Creates rooms and structures whose layout, wear, objects, access, and transformation reveal story.

skills.name: Journey and Travel Designer
skills.description: Plans route, distance, obstacles, encounters, changing relationships, logistics, discovery, and arrival payoff.

skills.name: Place-Based Mystery Designer
skills.description: Embeds clues, contradictions, hidden layers, witnesses, and past events into a location.

skills.name: Spatial Blocking Writer
skills.description: Tracks character positions, movement, sightlines, objects, entrances, exits, and physical interactions in prose or scripts.

skills.name: Environmental Storytelling Designer
skills.description: Communicates events and lives through arrangement, damage, traces, objects, architecture, and absence.

skills.name: Map-to-Story Integrator
skills.description: Uses maps to test distance, routes, borders, resources, conflict, travel time, and scene geography.

skills.name: Location Continuity Auditor
skills.description: Tracks layouts, distances, access, weather, light, occupants, damage, and changes across scenes.

skills.name: Place Bible Author
skills.description: Documents maps, districts, rooms, sensory details, history, inhabitants, routes, rules, and story uses.

skills.name: Faction Designer
skills.description: Creates groups with purpose, ideology, resources, structure, membership, rituals, rivals, fractures, and public image.

skills.name: Institution Designer
skills.description: Builds schools, militaries, guilds, corporations, governments, orders, families, and criminal organizations with operating logic.

skills.name: Alliance and Rivalry Mapper
skills.description: Tracks cooperation, leverage, debt, betrayal, competition, neutrality, and changing relationships among groups.

skills.name: Political Intrigue Architect
skills.description: Designs agendas, secrets, offices, succession, coalitions, scandals, information, and public consequences.

skills.name: War and Campaign Narrative Designer
skills.description: Creates strategic goals, logistics, command, fronts, civilian effects, morale, intelligence, and meaningful turning points.

skills.name: Rebellion and Revolution Designer
skills.description: Builds grievances, organization, factions, state response, escalation, legitimacy, sacrifice, and possible aftermaths.

skills.name: Criminal Underworld Designer
skills.description: Creates markets, crews, territory, codes, protection, corruption, enforcement, and social connections.

skills.name: Diplomacy and Negotiation Designer
skills.description: Builds interests, red lines, concessions, credibility, signaling, domestic pressure, and agreement consequences.

skills.name: Social Class and Power Designer
skills.description: Shows how wealth, status, law, education, identity, and access shape opportunity and relationships.

skills.name: Faction Character Integrator
skills.description: Connects institutions to personal loyalties, careers, family, belief, fear, betrayal, and change.

skills.name: Conflict Network Auditor
skills.description: Checks incentives, resources, communication, escalation, alliances, and unintended easy resolutions.

skills.name: Faction Bible Author
skills.description: Documents leadership, ranks, assets, ideology, methods, symbols, locations, history, members, and current goals.

skills.name: Fantasy Story Designer
skills.description: Creates wonder, myth, magic, quests, cultures, power, and consequences across epic, dark, cozy, urban, and other fantasy forms.

skills.name: Science Fiction Story Designer
skills.description: Creates technology, exploration, societies, identity, ethics, and change across hard, space opera, cyberpunk, and other forms.

skills.name: Mystery and Detective Story Designer
skills.description: Creates fair clues, investigation, suspects, motive, misdirection, discovery, and solution.

skills.name: Thriller and Suspense Designer
skills.description: Creates threat, pursuit, uncertainty, urgency, reversals, vulnerability, and accelerating consequence.

skills.name: Horror Story Designer
skills.description: Creates dread, vulnerability, violation, uncertainty, escalation, imagery, and aftermath across horror subgenres.

skills.name: Romance Story Designer
skills.description: Builds attraction, compatibility, conflict, vulnerability, trust, intimacy, choice, and an appropriate emotional ending.

skills.name: Comedy Story Designer
skills.description: Creates comic premises, character engines, timing, reversals, escalation, callbacks, and emotional grounding.

skills.name: Historical Fiction Designer
skills.description: Integrates researched period constraints, material life, language calibration, social context, and fictional drama.

skills.name: Adventure Story Designer
skills.description: Creates goals, travel, hazards, discoveries, companions, escalating trials, and transformative return.

skills.name: Slice-of-Life Story Designer
skills.description: Finds meaning, change, humor, intimacy, and theme in ordinary routines, relationships, and small decisions.

skills.name: Genre Hybrid Architect
skills.description: Combines genre promises deliberately, deciding which rules dominate each scene and how expectations interact.

skills.name: Genre Promise Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether setup, tone, conflict, pacing, imagery, and ending satisfy or purposefully transform audience expectations.

skills.name: Novel Architecture Designer
skills.description: Plans premise, acts, parts, chapters, plotlines, viewpoints, arcs, reveals, and length targets for a complete novel.

skills.name: Novella Designer
skills.description: Creates concentrated long-form fiction with limited cast, strong central movement, and proportionate worldbuilding.

skills.name: Light Novel Designer
skills.description: Builds accessible prose, strong character hooks, visual moments, chapter rhythm, illustrations, and volume-level payoff.

skills.name: Literary Fiction Designer
skills.description: Creates voice-led, psychologically precise, thematically layered stories with purposeful structure and image systems.

skills.name: Commercial Fiction Designer
skills.description: Balances concept, clarity, momentum, emotional reward, genre promise, and series potential for broad readership.

skills.name: Multi-Viewpoint Novel Designer
skills.description: Coordinates perspective selection, distribution, voice, chronology, information, and converging arcs.

skills.name: Epistolary Novel Designer
skills.description: Creates stories through letters, messages, logs, reports, transcripts, posts, and document gaps with credible provenance.

skills.name: Frame Narrative Novel Designer
skills.description: Builds framing and embedded narratives whose narrators, timelines, and meanings affect one another.

skills.name: Novel Chapter Drafting Specialist
skills.description: Drafts complete chapters from approved scene goals while preserving voice, continuity, pacing, and future setup.

skills.name: Long-Prose Continuity Manager
skills.description: Tracks canon, timeline, knowledge, objects, promises, motifs, arcs, formatting, and unresolved setups across large manuscripts.

skills.name: Novel Revision Planner
skills.description: Creates pass-based revisions for structure, character, theme, scenes, prose, continuity, and proofreading.

skills.name: Volume and Series Ending Specialist
skills.description: Creates satisfying book-level closure while preserving larger questions, arcs, and future momentum.

skills.name: Short Story Designer
skills.description: Creates a complete change, revelation, decision, or emotional movement within a compressed cast and world.

skills.name: Flash Fiction Writer
skills.description: Produces very short stories with precision, implication, image, compression, and resonant endings.

skills.name: Microfiction Writer
skills.description: Creates story movement in a paragraph, sentence, social post, card, caption, or other tiny form.

skills.name: Anthology Story Designer
skills.description: Creates standalone stories that contribute distinct angles to a shared theme, world, event, or constraint.

skills.name: Linked Story Cycle Designer
skills.description: Connects separate stories through place, characters, motifs, history, or consequences into a larger pattern.

skills.name: Twist Short Story Specialist
skills.description: Builds economical setups whose final turn is fair, transformative, and more than a trick.

skills.name: Slice Short Story Specialist
skills.description: Captures a decisive interval whose emotional or thematic meaning extends beyond the narrated time.

skills.name: Experimental Short Form Designer
skills.description: Uses fragments, lists, instructions, documents, constraints, or unusual viewpoints while maintaining purpose.

skills.name: Oral Tale and Campfire Story Writer
skills.description: Creates rhythmic, memorable, performable stories with repetition, escalation, audience awareness, and payoff.

skills.name: Children’s Short Story Writer
skills.description: Creates age-appropriate conflict, language, repetition, warmth, agency, imagery, and resolution.

skills.name: Short Fiction Compression Editor
skills.description: Removes redundancy while preserving clarity, voice, emotional logic, and necessary setup.

skills.name: Short Form Ending Editor
skills.description: Strengthens final images, turns, echoes, decisions, or revelations without over-explaining them.

categories.name: Interactive Fiction, Games, and Player Choice

skills.name: Game Narrative Director
skills.description: Aligns story, mechanics, progression, player agency, world, characters, quests, interface, audio, and production constraints.

skills.name: Branching Narrative Architect
skills.description: Builds choices, branches, merges, variables, states, routes, consequences, and endings without uncontrolled explosion.

skills.name: Choice Design Specialist
skills.description: Creates choices with understandable stakes, distinct values, meaningful uncertainty, and visible or delayed consequence.

skills.name: Consequence System Designer
skills.description: Tracks immediate, systemic, relational, reputational, resource, and ending consequences across player actions.

skills.name: Player Agency Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether player decisions meaningfully affect strategy, relationships, information, world state, or self-definition.

skills.name: Narrative State Machine Designer
skills.description: Defines flags, variables, conditions, transitions, dependencies, fallbacks, and save-compatible story states.

skills.name: Quest Narrative Designer
skills.description: Creates quest goals, motivation, steps, complications, optional approaches, world integration, rewards, and aftermath.

skills.name: Side Quest Designer
skills.description: Creates optional stories that deepen character, place, theme, mechanics, or consequences rather than feeling disposable.

skills.name: Environmental Narrative Designer
skills.description: Places story in spaces, objects, encounters, audio, text, changes, and player discovery.

skills.name: Gameplay Dialogue Designer
skills.description: Writes responsive barks, prompts, banter, reactions, tutorials, combat lines, and state- dependent conversations.

skills.name: Narrative Systems QA Designer
skills.description: Creates tests for unreachable content, contradictory flags, broken routes, repeated dialogue, missing consequences, and save states.

skills.name: Game Ending Matrix Designer
skills.description: Builds coherent ending families from major choices, relationships, world states, themes, and player identity.

skills.name: Visual Novel Route Architect
skills.description: Designs common route, character routes, locks, branching, bad ends, true routes, and completion flow.

skills.name: Visual Novel Scene Writer
skills.description: Writes screen-sized narration and dialogue with sprite, background, sound, transition, and choice cues.

skills.name: Route Romance Designer
skills.description: Builds distinct relationship arcs with chemistry, vulnerability, conflict, consent, trust, and route-specific payoff.

skills.name: Visual Novel Choice Designer
skills.description: Creates choices that express personality, reveal information, alter relationships, and change routes or states.

skills.name: Affinity and Flag System Designer
skills.description: Defines relationship values, hidden conditions, event gates, route locks, and readable debugging outputs.

skills.name: Visual Novel Pacing Specialist
skills.description: Balances dialogue, narration, choice frequency, saves, reveals, CG events, quiet scenes, and route length.

skills.name: Sprite and Expression Scriptwriter
skills.description: Specifies character position, pose, expression, entrance, exit, layering, and change timing.

skills.name: CG and Key Scene Planner
skills.description: Identifies major illustrated moments, compositions, character staging, emotional purpose, and alternate variants.

skills.name: Visual Novel Audio Cue Designer
skills.description: Places music, ambience, effects, silence, fades, stingers, and voice direction for dramatic function.

skills.name: Bad Ending and Failure Route Designer
skills.description: Creates meaningful failure outcomes that reveal character, world, risk, or strategy rather than arbitrary punishment.

skills.name: True Ending Architect
skills.description: Builds a culmination that recontextualizes routes, resolves central mysteries, and rewards completion.

skills.name: Visual Novel Continuity QA Specialist
skills.description: Tests route knowledge, flags, repeated scenes, sprite states, pronouns, names, saves, and ending conditions.

skills.name: RPG Campaign Architect
skills.description: Designs campaign premise, tiers, locations, factions, arcs, villains, clues, sessions, and flexible conclusions.

skills.name: Adventure Module Writer
skills.description: Creates playable scenarios with hooks, locations, encounters, NPCs, secrets, choices, consequences, and referee guidance.

skills.name: Quest Chain Designer
skills.description: Builds linked quests with progression, changing contexts, recurring characters, choices, and cumulative consequences.

skills.name: NPC Designer
skills.description: Creates gameable non-player characters with goals, voice, leverage, information, behavior, relationships, and response to players.

skills.name: Villain Campaign Planner
skills.description: Designs antagonist goals, timelines, resources, reactions, mistakes, lieutenants, contingencies, and visible world effects.

skills.name: Faction Play Designer
skills.description: Creates faction goals, projects, clocks, offers, conflicts, ranks, rewards, and reactions to player behavior.

skills.name: Encounter Narrative Designer
skills.description: Gives combat, social, exploration, puzzle, and hazard encounters purpose, context, stakes, alternatives, and aftermath.

skills.name: Sandbox Story Designer
skills.description: Creates locations, factions, pressures, rumors, opportunities, and event clocks that generate story from player action.

skills.name: Session Arc Designer
skills.description: Builds a playable session with opening, choices, discoveries, escalation, climax, and next- session momentum.

skills.name: Game Master Support Writer
skills.description: Creates concise descriptions, improvisation prompts, contingency guidance, secrets, voices, and quick-reference material.

skills.name: Character Backstory Integration Designer
skills.description: Connects player histories to factions, places, threats, opportunities, revelations, and campaign decisions.

skills.name: Campaign Continuity Keeper
skills.description: Tracks sessions, choices, NPC states, locations, inventory, promises, clues, consequences, and unresolved threads.

categories.name: Comics, Manga, Manhwa, and Sequential Art

skills.name: Sequential Story Architect
skills.description: Transforms a narrative into issues, chapters, scenes, pages, panels, reveals, and visual beats.

skills.name: Comic Script Writer
skills.description: Writes page-and-panel scripts with action, dialogue, captions, sound effects, setting, and essential visual direction.

skills.name: Manga Chapter Designer
skills.description: Plans pacing, page turns, spreads, panel rhythm, emotional beats, action clarity, and chapter hooks.

skills.name: Webtoon Episode Designer
skills.description: Creates vertical-scroll pacing, spacing, mobile reveals, rhythm, cliffhangers, and reusable production structure.

skills.name: Anachronism and Plausibility Auditor
skills.description: Checks objects, language, institutions, travel, technology, customs, and knowledge against the declared period or world.

skills.name: Authenticity Limitation Reporter
skills.description: States which details were verified, inferred, simplified, disputed, or left intentionally fictional.

skills.name: Literary Translation Designer
skills.description: Preserves meaning, voice, rhythm, implication, imagery, register, and readability while documenting difficult choices.

skills.name: Dialogue Localization Specialist
skills.description: Adapts speech, idiom, humor, politeness, dialect function, and character distinction for the target language.

skills.name: Poetry Translation Specialist
skills.description: Balances meaning, image, sound, meter, rhyme, form, and cultural context according to declared priorities.

skills.name: Lyric Localization Specialist
skills.description: Adapts singability, stress, vowel shape, rhyme, timing, meaning, and character voice to music.

skills.name: Game Narrative Localization Designer
skills.description: Handles variables, choices, gender and number, UI limits, route logic, terminology, and context notes.

skills.name: Comic and Manga Localization Planner
skills.description: Adapts balloons, captions, sound effects, reading direction, space, cultural references, and lettering needs.

skills.name: Cultural Reference Adapter
skills.description: Replaces or explains references only when needed, preserving function, tone, and audience comprehension.

skills.name: Name and Terminology Localization Manager
skills.description: Maintains names, titles, invented terms, pronunciation, transliteration, capitalization, and glossary choices.

skills.name: Right-to-Left Narrative Layout Planner
skills.description: Adapts page order, panels, balloons, typography, navigation, and mixed-direction content.

skills.name: Localization Style Guide Author
skills.description: Defines voice, terminology, punctuation, honorifics, formatting, cultural choices, and prohibited inconsistencies.

skills.name: Back-Translation and Meaning Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether localized text preserves plot facts, character intent, clues, tone, and consequential choices.

skills.name: Multilingual Continuity Auditor
skills.description: Tracks terms, names, pronouns, route variables, rhymes, callbacks, and canon across language versions.

categories.name: Safety, Rights, Representation, and Narrative Ethics

skills.name: Story Rights and Source Reviewer
skills.description: Checks copyright status, permissions, public-domain claims, licenses, quotations, lyrics, trademarks, and adaptation scope.

skills.name: Likeness and Privacy Narrative Reviewer
skills.description: Checks consent, identifying detail, defamation risk, vulnerable people, minors, and fictionalization of real individuals.

skills.name: Representation Quality Reviewer
skills.description: Examines agency, diversity within groups, stereotype load, narrative punishment, voice, context, and character specificity.

skills.name: Trauma-Informed Story Reviewer
skills.description: Checks coercion, abuse, grief, violence, recovery, triggers, support, agency, and avoidable sensationalism.

skills.name: Age and Content Rating Planner
skills.description: Maps language, fear, violence, sexual content, substances, discrimination, and themes to the intended audience and platform.

skills.name: Content Note Designer
skills.description: Creates concise, useful notices that inform readers without unnecessarily spoiling the work.

skills.name: Ethical True Story Reviewer
skills.description: Checks sourcing, consent, composites, reconstruction, power, foreseeable harm, and disclosure in nonfiction narratives.

skills.name: Hateful Content Prevention Reviewer
skills.description: Rejects dehumanizing or targeted hateful treatment while preserving legitimate conflict, history, critique, and characterization.

skills.name: Romance and Consent Safety Reviewer
skills.description: Checks power, coercion, boundaries, age, communication, framing, and consequences in relationship narratives.

skills.name: Self-Harm and Suicide Narrative Safety Reviewer
skills.description: Promotes non-graphic, non-romanticized, recovery-aware handling with appropriate context and support orientation.

skills.name: Generative Story Provenance Manager
skills.description: Records prompts, source materials, references, edits, approvals, licenses, and disclosures for generated narrative content.

skills.name: Narrative Capability and Limitation Reporter
skills.description: States what was drafted, researched, verified, adapted, simulated, or left unresolved without unsupported claims.

categories.name: Narrative Automation, Tools, and Production Systems

skills.name: Story Outline Generator Designer
skills.description: Creates controllable outline workflows using structured inputs, constraints, alternatives, and human approval gates.

skills.name: Narrative Template System Designer
skills.description: Builds reusable templates for premises, characters, scenes, chapters, quests, routes, poems, scripts, and editorial notes.

skills.name: Story Database Builder
skills.description: Creates structured systems for canon, scenes, characters, places, events, items, relationships, and sources.

skills.name: Branching Story Data Engineer
skills.description: Represents nodes, choices, conditions, variables, effects, routes, localization, and validation in machine-readable form.

skills.name: Narrative Script Conversion Specialist
skills.description: Converts between prose outlines, screenplay formats, comic scripts, game dialogue, Twine, Ink, Yarn, and custom schemas.

skills.name: Automated Continuity Checker Designer
skills.description: Builds checks for names, dates, ages, flags, object states, character knowledge, terminology, and unresolved promises.

skills.name: Word Count and Page Budget Planner
skills.description: Allocates target lengths across acts, chapters, scenes, routes, songs, poems, panels, and production units.

skills.name: Narrative Version Control Planner
skills.description: Defines drafts, branches, merges, approvals, canon states, changelogs, and recovery without losing author edits.

skills.name: Batch Story Variant Generator
skills.description: Creates controlled variations by viewpoint, genre, tone, audience, choice, ending, length, or platform while tracking differences.

skills.name: Narrative QA Test Harness Designer
skills.description: Defines normal, boundary, route, continuity, formatting, localization, and reopen tests for story artifacts.

skills.name: Writing Workflow Orchestrator
skills.description: Coordinates ideation, research, outline, drafting, review, revision, production, validation, and publication handoff.

skills.name: Narrative Production Recovery Coordinator
skills.description: Preserves passing work, isolates the earliest failure, repairs the smallest responsible layer, and reruns affected checks.

categories.name: Experimental, Hybrid, and Emerging Narrative Forms

skills.name: Interactive Poetry Designer
skills.description: Creates poems whose order, choices, links, variables, or reader actions alter rhythm, meaning, and outcome.

skills.name: Procedural Narrative Designer
skills.description: Creates rules, content pools, constraints, states, and selection logic that generate coherent story variation.

skills.name: Emergent Story Systems Designer
skills.description: Builds characters, goals, simulation states, memory, relationships, and world events that produce unscripted narratives.

skills.name: Found Document Narrative Designer
skills.description: Tells stories through reports, messages, files, receipts, maps, evidence, marginalia, and gaps.

skills.name: Unreliable Interface Narrative Designer
skills.description: Uses menus, logs, notifications, errors, system messages, and changing interfaces as story mechanisms.

skills.name: Alternate Reality Story Designer
skills.description: Creates cross-platform clues, artifacts, websites, messages, events, communities, and real- time progression with safety boundaries.

skills.name: Location-Based Narrative Designer
skills.description: Connects story events to physical places, routes, landmarks, timing, and accessible alternatives.

skills.name: AI Character Conversation Designer
skills.description: Defines character voice, memory, boundaries, goals, canon, safety, fallback, and continuity for interactive dialogue.

skills.name: Dynamic Personalized Story Designer
skills.description: Adapts approved variables such as name, difficulty, interest, or prior choice while preserving quality and privacy.

skills.name: Translinear Narrative Designer
skills.description: Creates networks of fragments that can be entered in multiple orders yet accumulate coherent meaning.

skills.name: Mixed-Media Literature Designer
skills.description: Combines prose, image, sound, video, typography, interaction, and performance into one purposeful literary experience.

skills.name: Experimental Form Coherence Auditor
skills.description: Checks whether formal innovation strengthens meaning, orientation, accessibility, emotional effect, and completion.
